meta_data.base_class: retrieve the report of a patient's <medical imaging examination> - these examinations share the same parameter structure but differ in imaging region or modality.

tool_template.name: patient.get_<class>_report
tool_template.description: Fetch the <class> report of the patient for a given status.

status.description: Status of the <class> report, could be 'in progress', 'concluded' or 'draft'.

report_date.description: The date when the <class> report was generated.

image_quality.description: The quality of the images in the <class> report, such as 'high', 'medium', or 'low'.

include_ai_analysis.description: If true, includes AI-assisted quantitative findings or measurements from the <class> report, when available.

language.description: Specifies the preferred language for the <class> report, e.g., 'en' or 'zh'.
